description: Saves a named unit configuration using datasheet and choice ids from get_unit_options. Use a new UUID for a new configuration. Reusing an id keeps the first saved configuration. Use rename_unit_loadout to change its name. Requires mcp:manage.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

choices.description: One option per choice group, choice key to option id from get_unit_options, for groups it sets with choices: wargear, an enhancement, a detachment upgrade. Omitted groups keep their default; '' leaves an optional group empty.

entryId.description: Unit id from list_units or get_unit_options.

models.description: Unit size; defaults to the minimum.

spreads.description: How many models take each option of a group get_unit_options sets with spreads: choice key to {option id: count}. A group is in choices or spreads, never both.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.
